apps.name: Nuvio
apps.subtitle: Open-source media player, bring your own sources
apps.localizedDescription: Nuvio is a free, open-source media app for your phone, desktop and the TV you already own. Bring your own sources - Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles and your place saved on every screen.
apps.versionDescription:
Nuvio 0.6.3 | nuvio-0.6.3-full-release

- d45d4d36 fix(party): show the party's source as plain text @tapframe  
- 37a6656a fix(player): keep center controls in place on pause @tapframe  
- 344117e7 feat(player): show badges for what is playing @tapframe  
- ebb17678 feat(party): chat from your phone with the same profile @tapframe  
- 18268427 fix(player): move engine switch to top row with confirmation @tapframe  
- [feat(i18n): add Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) localization for watch party, servers, mdblist and autosync (#2288)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2288) @jhojhocraazy  
- b8249380 fix(party): send chat messages with the return key @tapframe  
- [Update Hungarian translations (#2333)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2333) @emgeje  
- [Fix binge group initial state from stream args, apply custom posters in library see-all (#2332)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2332) @skoruppa  
- [i18n(vi): update strings.xml, translate watch party and auto sync strings into Vietnamese (#2297)](https://github.com/NuvioMedia/NuvioMobile/pull/2297) @blueocean2308
